name: Steve Schoger
bio: Steve Schoger is a Canadian visual designer known for sharing UI tips publicly and for Refactoring UI, the book and video course made with Adam Wathan. His site describes teaching web design through specific, actionable tactics and refactoring UIs in public. Work centers on practical visual craft rather than theory-only critique.
highlights: Co-author of Refactoring UI with Adam Wathan.
Catalogued techniques from public Refactoring UI tips (hierarchy, whitespace, borders).
Known for public UI tips and refactor videos.
